name: Seungyeol Ryu
bio: I work on surface defect detection with noisy training data, classifier selection for time series, and federated learning for industrial data.

research.title: An Adaptive Contrastive Learning-Based Robust Surface Defect Detection Model for Noisy Datasets
research.credit: Seungyeol Ryu, Geonwoo Kim, and Jaeyeon Jang
research.summary: The method uses a t-test to adjust the contrastive loss temperature when defective images are mixed into the training set.

research.title: Adaptive Model Selection for Time-Series Classification with Language Model
